date: Nov 12, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 4 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Thirty seconds, no rabbit hole
cards.question: PCIe Gen5 margin falls from 1.1 to 0.4 dB before release. How do you brief the director?
cards.selfCheck: Lead with exposure, release impact, confidence, and the decision needed. Exercise: give a 30-second update without explaining the full channel model.
cards.prompt: Coach my 30-second director update: PCIe Gen5 margin declined from 1.1 to 0.4 dB before release. Challenge risk framing, confidence and ask.

cards.title: Progress is not the headline
cards.question: You completed 12 EM sweeps but still cannot correlate a TDR discontinuity. What matters?
cards.selfCheck: Report the unresolved signoff consequence and discriminating next test, not simulation count. Exercise: replace a progress-only update with one decision-ready sentence.
cards.prompt: Critique a progress-heavy EM/TDR status report and rewrite it as a concise decision-ready risk update with owner and checkpoint.

cards.title: When asked: Any concerns?
cards.question: A 19 MHz PDN peak may violate transient margin; the load spectrum is not final. What do you say?
cards.selfCheck: Say 'Yes—potential droop risk, medium confidence' and name the missing load spectrum, owner and test date. Exercise: distinguish likelihood from consequence.
cards.prompt: Role-play a manager asking 'Any concerns?' about a 19 MHz PDN resonance with incomplete transient data. Coach concise confidence language.

cards.title: Make the layout ask easy to accept
cards.question: A crosstalk fix needs 0.3 mm more spacing, but routing is nearly frozen. How do you gain agreement?
cards.selfCheck: State system impact and two layout options; ask for a bounded feasibility check before freeze. Exercise: make the request in 20 seconds without blaming layout.
cards.prompt: Role-play a layout lead resisting a 0.3 mm spacing change for crosstalk mitigation. Coach an influence-based request with alternatives and a deadline.

cards.title: The checkpoint is the commitment
cards.question: Yesterday's connector EM/TDR mismatch still lacks closure. What should your follow-up contain?
cards.selfCheck: Give new evidence, remaining uncertainty, accountable owner, and next decision checkpoint. Exercise: deliver a three-sentence update and specify an escalation trigger.
cards.prompt: Quiz me on closing the loop on a connector EM/TDR discrepancy. Demand a clear owner, test, deadline, and escalation trigger.
